description:
Long-running daemon. v2 was Ollama-generated and broken (wrong HTTP method, hallucinated imports, no daemon scaffolding); v3 must follow the EXACT pattern below.

MODEL THIS FILE ON candidate_promoter_daemon.py which is already on disk and works. Same logging style (single FileHandler), same heartbeat thread, same single-instance lockfile, same ws_query/ws_write helper shape.

WORKFLOW: Every 600s, POST to http://127.0.0.1:8772/query (NOT GET) with json={'sql': 'SELECT server_id FROM mcp_server_registry r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_fingerprints f WHERE f.server_id = r.server_id) LIMIT 30'}, timeout=10. Iterate the response.json()['rows'] (which is a LIST of dicts, NOT a dict-of-records).

For each server_id row, do this in a try/except per-server: import the SIBLING module 'mcp_fingerprinter' (a single existing file at /home/workspace/zo_sentinel/mcp_fingerprinter.py -- use 'import mcp_fingerprinter' at the TOP of the file, NEVER importlib.import_module with a dynamic name), call mcp_fingerprinter.fingerprint(server_id) inside a 5-second wall-clock budget, and if it returns a non-None dict, POST to http://127.0.0.1:8772/write with json={'table': 'mcp_fingerprints', 'rows': fingerprint_row, 'wait': True}, timeout=10.

MAP the fingerprint() return value to the LIVE schema (verified via information_schema.columns): mcp_fingerprints columns are EXACTLY (server_id, tool_name_hash, description_tokens, permission_scope_hash, domain_fingerprint, version_string, computed_at). Do NOT use tool_count or prompt_count or resource_count -- those columns do not exist. If fingerprint() returns extra fields, drop them silently. If it doesn't return a required column, set it to NULL. Always set computed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().

Heartbeat thread every 30s writes to service_health table {service: 'fingerprint_runner_daemon_v3', last_heartbeat: ISO timestamp}. Single-instance lockfile at /home/workspace/logs/fingerprint_runner_daemon_v3.lock with PID. NEVER imports duckdb or sqlite3. Logging.basicConfig with handlers=[logging.FileHandler('/home/workspace/logs/fingerprint_runner_daemon_v3.log')] -- NO StreamHandler (nohup pipes stdout to the same file and StreamHandler doubles every line). Logs INFO line per cycle: 'cycle done: targets=N fingerprinted=M errors=K timeouts=T'. Sleeps 600s between cycles.
